findings.highlight: Pure white sunlight shines in through the window
findings.evidenceJa: 外は気持ちのいい快晴らしい
findings.governingReading: outside appears to be pleasantly clear and sunny
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents light entering through a window and omits the inferred fair weather.

findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の悪寒
findings.governingReading: last night’s chills
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes chills into fever and shifts the explicit nighttime anchor to the whole prior day.

findings.highlight: I sigh and think it over
findings.evidenceJa: 溜息をついて反省する
findings.governingReading: he sighs and reflects critically on his own conduct
findings.explanation: Self-reproach becomes neutral consideration.

findings.evidenceJa: 公園で倒れてからの記憶
findings.governingReading: his memory after collapsing in the park is vague
findings.explanation: The event and place from which Shirou’s memory becomes unreliable disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに肩を貸してもらって
findings.governingReading: Saber lending him her shoulder for support
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds home as the destination and generalizes the physical support.

findings.evidenceJa: 手早く制服に着替える
findings.governingReading: quickly changes into his uniform
findings.explanation: The briskness of Shirou’s morning preparation disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 居間にいるだろう桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura, who is probably in the living room
findings.explanation: Shirou’s expectation of Sakura’s location becomes fact before he enters.

findings.evidenceJa: 居間には、鞄を手にした桜
findings.governingReading: in the living room, Sakura is standing with her bag in hand
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits both the location and Sakura holding the bag.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしはいいです
findings.governingReading: I do not need breakfast
findings.explanation: Sakura’s refusal of her own meal becomes a generic claim that she is fine.

findings.highlight: because of the terrible condition you were in
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が倒れかけてるのを見て
findings.governingReading: on seeing Senpai on the verge of collapsing
findings.explanation: A specific observed near-collapse becomes Sakura’s broader diagnosis of a terrible condition.

findings.evidenceJa: ついカッとなっちゃって
findings.governingReading: she lost her temper in a sudden flash
findings.explanation: The involuntary suddenness of Sakura’s anger disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 今はセイバーさんに会わせる顔がなくて
findings.governingReading: right now she is too ashamed to face Saber
findings.explanation: A present emotional state is recast as a day-long schedule.

findings.evidenceJa: しゅん、と肩を狭めて俯く
findings.governingReading: she draws her shoulders inward dejectedly and lowers her head
findings.explanation: Most of Sakura’s contracted, dispirited posture disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 一番悪いのは怪我をした俺
findings.governingReading: the person most at fault is Shirou, who got injured
findings.explanation: A comparative assumption of primary responsibility becomes exclusive fault.

findings.evidenceJa: 一生懸命やってるヤツ
findings.governingReading: people who earnestly give their all
findings.explanation: Saber’s regard for earnest sustained effort becomes a minimal attempt threshold.

findings.highlight: I should reserve myself all the more
findings.evidenceJa: 今朝は遠慮します
findings.governingReading: she will refrain and keep her distance this morning
findings.explanation: mirror moon produces non-English phrasing and obscures Sakura’s concrete decision to withdraw from breakfast.

findings.highlight: Sakura bows to hide her embarrassment
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しのように笑って、桜はぺこりとお辞儀
findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles as though hiding embarrassment, then gives a small bow
findings.explanation: The concealment motive shifts from Sakura’s smile to her bow, and the smallness of the bow disappears.

findings.highlight: going to school early no matter what
findings.evidenceJa: 考えは変わらないようだ
findings.governingReading: her plan to go to school ahead of them appears unchanged
findings.explanation: An unchanged plan becomes defiant determination against opposition.

findings.evidenceJa: 朝練、禁止されてる
findings.governingReading: morning practice is prohibited
findings.explanation: An institutional ban becomes a temporary administrative suspension.

findings.highlight: to make her go so far
findings.evidenceJa: 誰もが嫌がる道場の雑巾がけを自分に課す
findings.governingReading: she imposes on herself the dojo floor-wiping that everyone hates
findings.explanation: The concrete severity and self-imposed nature of Sakura’s punishment disappear.

findings.highlight: What did she say to Saber
findings.evidenceJa: どんな口上でセイバーにケンカを売った
findings.governingReading: what sort of declaration she used to pick a fight with Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s vivid, limited speculation about the wording of Sakura’s challenge becomes a neutral question.
